partitions.confirmation: route out before any rating-axis parsing

evaluator_split.rule: sort all 600 evaluator_index values by SHA256(seed + NUL + evaluator_index); first 300 are A and remaining 300 are B

measurement.statistic: Spearman correlation with average ranks for ties across eligible stories, independently by partition and axis
